model_annotation: Figure 15 displays the distribution of quantifiers and operations across three subfields of numerical reasoning: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive. The figure consists of three separate pie charts, each corresponding to one of these subfields. The first pie chart, labeled "Categorical," is divided into four segments: "Existential Quantifiers" (15.12%, light green), "Negation" (27.91%, orange), "Universal Quantifiers" (29.07%, light blue), and "Limiter" (27.91%, light pink). The second pie chart, "Approximate Number Generation," shows three segments: "Absolute Absence" (18.71%, light blue), "Approximate Quantities" (45.03%, light yellow), and "Comparative Relationships" (36.26%, medium blue). The third pie chart, "Disjunctive & Conjunctive," is composed of two segments: "Disjunctive" (49.51%, light purple) and "Conjunctive" (50.49%, darker purple). The percentages are explicitly labeled within each slice of the pie charts.
